derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040s1a.pdf (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. This form's AcroForm root is form1[0]. Only Part I (MAGI), Part V (enhanced deduction for seniors) and Part VI (total) are mapped: Parts II (tips), III (overtime) and IV (car loan interest) are not modeled in v1 and no input can produce them, so their fields stay blank. Line 1 = Form 1040 line 11 (AGI; the printed form cites line 11b); line 3 = MAGI (lines 2a-2e excluded-income items blank in v1). Part V fields are on page 2 (f2_15..f2_23 in order: lines 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36a, 36b, 37, 38), each matched to its printed label row.

entries.note: 'Name(s) shown on Form 1040' field; filled from the stored identity when present.
'Your social security number' field; digits-only; report value masked.
Part I line 1 (Form 1040 line 11 AGI); widget row y-center 666 matches the printed '1' label row.
Part I line 3 MAGI ('Add lines 1 and 2e'; lines 2a-2e blank in v1); widget row matches the printed '3' label row.
Part V line 31 'Enter the amount from line 3' (MAGI); widget row matches the printed '31' label row (page 2).
Part V line 32 threshold ($75,000 / $150,000 MFJ in TY2025); widget row matches the printed '32' label row.
Part V line 33 (line 31 minus line 32, floor zero); widget row matches the printed '33' label row.
Part V line 34 'Multiply line 33 by 6%'; widget row matches the printed '34' label row.
Part V line 35 per-person amount ($6,000 minus line 34, floor zero); widget row matches the printed '35' label rows.
Part V line 36a (taxpayer's line 35 amount when the taxpayer has a valid SSN and was born before January 2, 1961); widget row matches the printed '36a' label rows.
Part V line 36b (spouse's line 35 amount, MFJ only, same conditions); widget row matches the printed '36b' label rows.
Part V line 37 'Enhanced deduction for seniors. Add lines 36a and 36b'; widget row matches the printed '37' label row.
Part VI line 38 total additional deductions (lines 13 + 21 + 30 + 37; in v1 only line 37 can be nonzero), flows to Form 1040 line 13b; widget row matches the printed '38' label rows.
